text_en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I solemnly urge you:
text_cn: 我在天主和那要审判生死者的基督耶稣前，指着他的显现和他的国，恳求你：

text_en: proclaim the message; be persistent whether the time is favorable or unfavorable; convince, rebuke, and encourage, with the utmost patience in teaching.
text_cn: 务要宣讲真道，不论顺境逆境，总要坚持不变；以百般的忍耐和各样的教训去反驳，去斥责，去劝勉。

text_en: For the time is coming when people will not put up with sound doctrine, but having itching ears, they will accumulate for themselves teachers to suit their own desires,
text_cn: 因为时候将到，那时人不接受健全的道理，反因耳朵发痒，顺从自己的情欲，为自己聚拢许多师傅；

text_en: and will turn away from listening to the truth and wander away to myths.
text_cn: 且掩耳不听真理，偏去听那无稽的传说。

text_en: As for you, always be sober, endure suffering, do the work of an evangelist, carry out your ministry fully.
text_cn: 至于你，在一切事上务要谨慎，忍受艰苦，作传扬福音者的工作，完成你的职务。

text_en: As for me, I am already being poured out as a libation, and the time of my departure has come.
text_cn: 因为我已被奠祭，我离世的时期已经近了。

text_en: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
text_cn: 这场好仗，我已打完；这场赛跑，我已跑到终点；这信仰，我已保持了。

text_en: From now on there is reserved for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give me on that day, and not only to me but also to all who have longed for his appearing.
text_cn: 从今以后，正义的冠冕已为我预备下了，就是主，正义的审判者，到那一日必要赏给我的；不但赏给我，而且也赏给一切爱慕他显现的人。

text_en: Do your best to come to me soon,
text_cn: 你要赶快到我这里来！

text_en: for Demas, in love with this present world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
text_cn: 德玛斯因爱现世，已离弃我到得撒洛尼去了；克勒斯刻去了迦拉达，弟铎去了达耳玛提雅，

text_en: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful in my ministry.
text_cn: 只有路加同我在一起。你要带着马尔谷同你一起来，因为他在职务上为我是有用的。

text_en: I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
text_cn: 至于提希苛，我派他到厄弗所去了。

text_en: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, also the books, and above all the parchments.
text_cn: 我留在特洛阿卡尔颇家中的那件外衣，你来时务必带上，还有那几卷书，尤其是那些羊皮卷。

text_en: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm; the Lord will pay him back for his deeds.
text_cn: 铜匠亚历山大使我受了许多苦，主将照他所行的报应他。

text_en: You also must beware of him, for he strongly opposed our message.
text_cn: 这人你也要加意提防，因为他极力反抗我们的道理。

text_en: At my first defense no one came to my support, but all deserted me. May it not be counted against them!
text_cn: 在我初次过堂时，没有人在我身旁，众人都离弃了我，愿天主不归罪于他们！

text_en: But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. So I was rescued from the lion’s mouth.
text_cn: 但是主却在我左右，坚固了我，使福音的宣讲藉着我而完成，使一切外邦人都能听见；我也从狮子口中被救了出来。

text_en: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and save me for his heavenly kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 主要救我脱离各种凶恶的事，也要使我安全地进入他天上的国。愿光荣归于他，于无穷世之世！阿们。

text_en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
text_cn: 请问候普黎斯加、阿桂拉和敖乃息佛洛一家。

text_en: Erastus remained in Corinth; Trophimus I left ill in Miletus.
text_cn: 厄辣斯托仍留在格林多，特洛斐摩因患病，我将他留在米肋托。

text_en: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus sends greetings to you, as do Pudens and Linus and Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.
text_cn: 你要赶快在冬天以前来到。欧步罗、普登、理诺、克劳狄雅和所有的弟兄都问候你。

text_en: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
text_cn: 愿主与你的心灵同在！愿恩宠与你们同在！
